title: Female sterilization (tubal ligation)
what: The surgeon blocks the fallopian tubes so the egg and sperm cannot meet. This is usually done through small cuts under anesthesia.
why: When a woman is sure she does not want more children. This decision is usually permanent.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; you often go home the same day or the next day
tell_doctor: If you are sure of your decision. It is hard to undo
All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If you had belly surgery before
If you had problems with anesthesia

prepare.title: Decision
prepare.text: Talk with your doctor about other kinds of birth control. A consent form is usually signed ahead of time.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, swabs, and an ECG. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually you do not eat or drink for several hours before surgery. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Getting home
prepare.text: Bring someone with you. You cannot drive after anesthesia.

steps: You change, and an IV line is placed in your vein
You get anesthesia and fall asleep
The surgeon makes 2 to 3 small cuts in your belly
The tubes are blocked or removed
You wake up in the recovery room
feel: You may feel sleepy after anesthesia
Pain in the belly and at the cuts. You will get pain medicine
Your shoulder may hurt from the gas. It goes away in 1 to 2 days
after: Do not lift heavy things for 1 to 2 weeks
Stitches are removed or dissolve. The surgeon will tell you
Periods usually stay the same as before
The surgery does not protect against infections
red_flags: Severe belly pain or pain that keeps getting worse
Redness or pus at the cuts
A late period with pain low in the belly: see a doctor right away

faq.a: This decision is usually permanent. Repairing the tubes is difficult and does not always work.
Usually not. The ovaries keep working as before.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Bring your documents and someone to go with you. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
